subject: Runway alignment and delegation for model version cutover (press lane & exceptions)
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Park <katie@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-25 09:12 -0700
Subject: Runway alignment and delegation for model version cutover (press lane & exceptions)

Team —

We need to lock the operational runway for the v2.3 model cutover targeted for the weekend of Nov 6-7. High level asks:

1) Marissa: public comms + press lane sign-off (advise if we should loop Comms).
2) Ben: customer exceptions and mutual action plans — I expect a small set of enterprise customers will request staggered moves or extended fallbacks.
3) Priyom: on-call coverage & escalation ladder for the cutover window.

I attached a simple runway matrix (2026-10-25_cutover-runway-matrix.xlsx) with proposed milestones and owner rows. Please review and reply with:
- confirm owners for each milestone
- any known blocker customers (I listed Acme as a potential exception)
- suggested comms cadence for pre-cutover, blackout window, and post-cutover recovery

Goal: have a finalized ops plan and public comms draft by EOD Wednesday (10/28) so we can announce to affected customers on Friday. If anyone needs an exception template, see attachment exception-request-template.docx — Ben, if you prefer a different flow, flag it.

Thanks —
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Park <katie@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-25 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway alignment and delegation for model version cutover (press lane & exceptions)

Thanks Michael — quick notes from the enterprise exceptions lens:

- Acme Analytics: they asked to remain on v2.2 until Nov 20 due to a certified model validation cycle. I proposed a hard fallthrough where they stay on v2.2 + route to dedicated pool, but accept reduced latency guarantees for two weeks (their request). They submitted the formal exception via contracts@acme; I attached the email thread to the internal ticket (HS-987654321).
- Two other customers (internal: flagged by CS) may also ask for a one-week tail; we should be able to support up to 5 concurrent exceptions without SLA violation if we reserve a small dedicated pool and pin their routes.
- Process ask: we need a one-click exemption approval for customer success/AE to sign-off on low-risk tail requests. Otherwise approval latency will block Friday comms. The exception-request-template.docx is fine as-is for initial intake.

Operational asks for cutover:
- Reserve 2 dedicated pods for exception traffic Nov 6-14 (can be autoscale-disabled).
- Pre-cutover smoke tests against pinned routes on Nov 5th morning.
- If more than 3 enterprise exemptions are requested, escalate to Product (Michael) + Infra (Priyom) for capacity ops.

I can own the exception intake and the mutual action plan for customers needing tails; will prepare a short checklist and the acceptance wording for the customer comms.

-Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Engineering
ben@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-26 08:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway alignment and delegation for model version cutover (press lane & exceptions)

Adding comms thoughts.

- Press lane: we should treat the initial hosted API deprecation notice as a product update (no broad press) but prepare a short brief for press ops in case an outage is reported. I attached cutover-press-lane-brief.pdf with suggested Qs/As.
- Customer comms cadence suggestion:
  * Friday 10/30: targeted email to affected accounts (with exception intake link and MMP).
  * Monday 11/2: send API migration FAQ and sample code snippets; include a compatibility shim note.
  * Nov 6 AM: reminder and blackout reminder.
  * Nov 7 late PM: confirmation + rollback window status.

- Templates: we need a de-risked acceptance paragraph for customers that elect to remain on v2.2 (Ben — can you add the exact wording you plan to send?).
- Comms ownership: I will own the customer-visible templates and the FAQ page; Michael, please confirm whether we loop Comms for the press lane brief. I recommend looping them if Acme is vocal.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Marketing
marissa@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-27 16:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway alignment and delegation for model version cutover (press lane & exceptions)

Confirming on-call & ops readiness:

- On-call: I will staff primary on-call Nov 6 00:00-12:00 PT; Infra lead (TBD) will take 12:00-23:59. I can be reachable for exception capacity switches.
- Capacity hooks: I will pre-provision the two dedicated pods Ben requested and pin them by Nov 5 08:00 PT. Autoscaling disabled for the window; we will use manual scale-up if needed.
- Runbook: please add a short rollback checklist to the sheet ("cutover-runway-matrix") — I added a comment on the Drive link.
- Escalation ladder: Customer complains -> CS -> Ben -> Michael -> Exec on-call. For press issues escalate to Marissa who will engage Comms.

I'll also patch a short test to smoke test anomaly detection on v2.3 for high-latency traces on Nov 5.

-Priyom
